mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade ( id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, price DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0, description TEXT, images TEXT, author VARCHAR(64), date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
ALTER TABLE trade ADD COLUMN images TEXT
UPDATE trade SET images = img WHERE (images IS NULL OR images='') AND img IS NOT NULL AND img <> ''
UPDATE trade SET images = REPLACE(images, 'uploads/trade', '/uploads/trade') WHERE images LIKE 'uploads/trade%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade(title, price, description, images, author, date) VALUES(#{title}, #{price}, #{description}, #{images}, #{author}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date FROM trade ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date FROM trade WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id, title, price, description, images, author, date FROM trade WHERE author = #{author} ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200
